mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_user_id, email, display_name, avatar_url, raw_profile, last_login_time, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, deleted FROM sys_user_oauth WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_oauth (id, user_id, provider, provider_user_id, email, display_name, avatar_url, raw_profile, last_login_time) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{email}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl}, CAST(#{rawProfile} AS jsonb), #{lastLoginTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_oauth SET email = #{email}, display_name = #{displayName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, raw_profile = CAST(#{rawProfile} AS jsonb), last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false
